summary: Iteration 3 — OurRealm full responsive QA (frontend-only). Tested 16 routes (/, /signup, /signin, /home, /feed, /discover, /messages, /friends, /wallet, /profile, /public/stealth, /realms, /sounds, /settings, /modes, /notifications) at 8 viewports (320, 375, 390, 414, 430, 768, 1024, 1440) — total 128 page combos. Document-level horizontal overflow (document.documentElement.scrollWidth - window.innerWidth) was 0 on EVERY combo. Inner horizontal scrollers (.or-hscroll / overflow-x-auto) confirmed working on /home (TopStarBar right-icon NAV 348>163, MediaType chips 450>294, live-users row 583>294, sticky search/filter 598>274). Sign-up at 320px: ModeSwitcher pills scrollable (334>286), username/password inputs fit, suggestion chips render (4 chips for 'stealth' — stealth98/stealth_hq/the.stealth/stealth.realm), clicking @stealth98 chip fills field. /public/stealth at 320px: shows public-status-friends + public-message button, widget grid renders 2-col (140px 140px). /profile at 320: view_public button present, grid no overflow. Two CRITICAL bugs found: (1) BottomNav 'Profile' button extends OFF-SCREEN at 320px viewport (x=315, w=47.5, right=362 — outside the 320px viewport, so Profile is visually missing), (2) Clicking 'Message' on /public/stealth at 320px navigates to /feed instead of opening real-chat overlay (works at desktop). All other Phase 1+2 regression items verified: testfriend1 login works, suggestion chips, logo→signup nav, public/stealth friend status all correct.

ui_bugs.issue: At 320px viewport, the 'Profile' button is rendered OFF the viewport. Measured: bottom-nav container is 0..320, but bottom-profile button has x=315.08, width=47.5, right=362.63 — i.e. only ~5px of the button is visible and ~43px is clipped off-screen. The screenshot confirms only Home/Discover/For You/[+]/Wallet/Friends are visible at the bottom; Profile is missing entirely. Spec said 'BottomNav 6 nav buttons + center create button all fit; the Profile label is fully visible (not clipped) at 320px' — this is NOT met. Root cause: 6 equal flex items + one fixed 56px center button × current min-width per item × inner gaps exceed 320px - safe-area pads. Fix options: (a) further shrink center create to 48px below 360px width, (b) reduce per-button horizontal padding via responsive class, (c) reduce icon labels to 10px font on <360px, or (d) collapse 'Profile' & 'Friends' under an avatar menu on the smallest screens.

At 320px viewport, clicking [data-testid=public-message] on /public/stealth navigates to /feed instead of opening the [data-testid=real-chat-overlay] on top of /messages?to=stealth (this same click works correctly at 1440px desktop and successfully sends DMs). Likely cause: a wrapping <Link> or click handler conflict on small screens — possibly the button is wrapped by a stacked parent link that intercepts the click on touch/narrow layouts, or the navigate target is wrong when the layout switches to mobile. Repro: login as testfriend1@example.com/pass1234 → /public/stealth at width=320 → click Message.

issues: Spec says 'Join button full-width' but at 320 the submit button width is 230px while inner content width is ~280px (submit_full: false). It's still tappable but not edge-to-edge. Minor.

env(safe-area-inset-*) returns 0 in headless chromium without a notch, so the actual safe-area values can only be visually confirmed on a physical iPhone with a notch. The CSS does use env() with fallback 0 (Layout main padding-bottom resolves to 110px = base + env(0); BottomNav padding-bottom resolves to 0px because env(0)). Recommend manually verifying on an actual iPhone X+/iPhone 15 with viewport-fit=cover.

action_items: FIX BottomNav so all 6 buttons + center create button + Profile label fit visibly within 320px viewport. Currently Profile is rendered ~43px past the right edge of the viewport — completely off-screen for iPhone SE users. Options: scale down per-button padding/icon size further at <360px (the current sm:flex-[0_0_72px] / 0_0_56px split helped the create button but the remaining 6 outer buttons still overflow). Consider min-width:0 + flex-1 with text-[10px] labels under 360px.

FIX /public/stealth Message button on small viewports: at 320px clicking Message navigates to /feed instead of opening real-chat overlay. Verify the click handler / Link wrapping is not different between mobile and desktop layouts.

Public.jsx (or wherever public-message is rendered) — confirm that the Message button uses the SAME onClick or navigate('/messages?to=...') logic on both mobile and desktop; current behavior suggests a separate mobile branch or wrapped Link tag that breaks the chat-overlay flow at narrow widths.
index.css — fluid clamp typography and .or-hscroll utility are working well; consider exposing a CSS custom property --nav-min-width so future bottom-nav adjustments don't require code changes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Responsive sweep at 320/375/390/414/430/768/1024/1440 is comprehensive and shows 0 document-level overflow on every route. The two outstanding bugs are both 320px-only: (1) BottomNav Profile button clipped off-screen at 320 — verify visually via a screenshot of the bottom 80px of /home at width=320; the Profile button right-edge measures 362px while viewport is 320px. (2) /public/stealth Message button at 320px navigates to /feed not /messages?to=stealth with real-chat overlay — works at 1440. Re-test after fixes by repeating the playwright probe from this iteration: login as testfriend1, set viewport 320, goto /public/stealth, click [data-testid=public-message], assert [data-testid=real-chat-overlay] is present AND page.url contains '/messages?to=stealth'.
rca_of_the_issue: BUG 1 (BottomNav Profile clipped at 320): the bottom-nav uses 6 nav buttons + 1 center create button on a flex row. Even with the recent reduction of the center button to 52px on sm screens, the remaining 6 buttons retain per-item min-width and horizontal padding that sum to >320px total content. Because the bottom-nav is positioned with fixed full-width and `overflow:hidden` (or implicit clip via document overflow:hidden on html/body), the last button (Profile) just falls outside the right edge silently without triggering document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth. Fix: scale each non-center button's horizontal padding/gap proportional to viewport <360px (use Tailwind arbitrary px-1.5 sm:px-2 or text-[10px] labels). BUG 2 (Message → /feed at 320): unable to fully RCA without code inspection; suggest checking Public profile component for any responsive conditional that wraps the Message button in an unintended Link or invokes a different navigate path on mobile breakpoints, and ensure the existing onClick handler that sets ?to=stealth & opens overlay isn't being shadowed by an outer click handler at narrow widths.
